name: Ravenous Hand
summary:
The Onyx Mirage keeps the lights on, the drinks flowing, and the debts endless.

Night after night, you spin the wheel, deal the hands, and tell yourself if you work hard enough, you'll make it out. But in a city where luck runs dry and organized crime rules the streets, all it takes is catching the wrong person's eye to turn your life into the next wager...

This demo was created for the Yandere Game Jam 2025 and features one yandere Love Interest.
